page: Google Cloud Platform n4d-standard-80 is an x86_64 architecture server instance belonging to the n4d family. It features 80 dedicated virtual CPUs paired with 320.0 GB of system memory. This configuration yields a balanced resource density of 4.0 GB of RAM per core, aligning with standard general-purpose computing profiles.

This server type does not include local NVMe SSD storage or integrated GPU hardware accelerators, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. Additionally, it does not bundle complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Given its high core count and balanced memory-to-core ratio, the n4d-standard-80 offers qualitative cost efficiency for workloads requiring substantial parallel processing without massive memory footprints. It is suited for multi-threaded applications, enterprise web serving, containerized microservices, and general-purpose backend processing.
